intent: HistoryBatch groups the history entries of one delivered event with its tenant id and optional prompt and completion token counts. carriesUsage is true when both counts are non-negative and false for the -1 sentinel used by tool-call events. The entry list is copied immutably; blank tenant or empty entries are refused.

methods.signature: HistoryBatch(String tenantId, List<HistoryEntry> entries, int promptTokens, int completionTokens)
methods.semantics: rejects blank tenantId and null or empty entries; entries copied immutably
true when both token counts are non-negative (usage is recorded); false for the -1 tool-call sentinel (no usage recorded)
